mapper.sql: select 'POST_LIKE' as kind, l.created_at, coalesce(u.display_name, '路过的人') as actor_name, u.avatar_url as actor_avatar_url, l.user_id as actor_user_id, p.id as post_id, left(p.content, 80) as excerpt, null as comment_content from post_like l join post p on p.id = l.post_id left join app_user u on u.id = l.user_id where p.author_id = #{userId} and (l.user_id is null or l.user_id != #{userId}) union all select 'COMMENT_LIKE' as kind, l.created_at, coalesce(u.display_name, '路过的人') as actor_name, u.avatar_url as actor_avatar_url, l.user_id as actor_user_id, p.id as post_id, left(p.content, 80) as excerpt, c.content as comment_content from comment_like l join comment c on c.id = l.comment_id join post p on p.id = c.post_id left join app_user u on u.id = l.user_id where c.user_id = #{userId} and (l.user_id is null or l.user_id != #{userId}) union all select 'COMMENT' as kind, c.created_at, case when c.user_id is null then c.nickname else coalesce(u.display_name, c.nickname) end as actor_name, case when c.user_id is null then c.avatar_url else u.avatar_url end as actor_avatar_url, c.user_id as actor_user_id, p.id as post_id, left(p.content, 80) as excerpt, c.content as comment_content from comment c join post p on p.id = c.post_id left join app_user u on u.id = c.user_id where p.author_id = #{userId} and (c.user_id is null or c.user_id != #{userId}) and c.status = 'VISIBLE'
mapper.select: select * from () as inbox order by created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
